reason: Added optional service_fee to Teller.checks_out_articles_from and Receipt. Validation rejects bool, non-numeric, negative, NaN, and infinity with ValueError. task: Add an optional service_fee to supermarket checkout and receipts. Public APIs must support Teller.checks_out_articles_from(cart, service_fee=0) and Receipt(service_fee=0). Existing calls without the argument must keep working. Add the fee exactly once after existing item prices and discounts. Accept finite int/float values greater than or equal to zero; reject negative values, NaN, infinity, strings, None and bool with a clear ValueError. Preserve existing quantities, prices and discounts. Python integers of any size, including 10**30 and 10**400, must work without OverflowError or loss of the item subtotal, including fractional amounts after discounts. For integer fees that would lose precision when added to a float, return an exact rational total; Python's standard-library fractions.Fraction is permitted. Do not approximate such totals with float or round away item amounts. Protected acceptance checks live outside your repository and can only be invoked with run_check. Do not search for their implementation. Find the relevant application modules yourself with the repository tools, implement the feature across the interacting modules, run feature, regression_core, regression_pricing and lint, and fix any failed checks before finishing.
